popover.Arrow.summary: Displays an element positioned against the popover anchor.

popover.Description.summary: A paragraph with additional information about the popover.

props.doc: Whether to keep the portal mounted in the DOM while the popup is hidden.
props.name: keepMounted

popover.Portal.summary: A portal element that moves the popup to a different part of the DOM.

props.doc: Whether to disable the popup from tracking any layout shift of its positioning anchor.
props.name: disableAnchorTracking

props.doc: How to align the popup relative to the specified side.
props.name: align

props.doc: Which side of the anchor element to align the popup against. May automatically change to avoid collisions.
props.name: side

props.doc: Minimum distance to maintain between the arrow and the edges of the popup. Use it to prevent the arrow element from hanging out of the rounded corners of a popup.
props.name: arrowPadding

props.doc: Determines how to handle collisions when positioning the popup. `side` controls overflow on the preferred placement axis (`top`/`bottom` or `left`/`right`): `'flip'`: keep the requested side when it fits; otherwise try the opposite side (`top` and `bottom`, or `left` and `right`).`'shift'`: never change side; keep the requested side and move the popup within the clipping boundary so it stays visible.`'none'`: do not correct side-axis overflow. `align` controls overflow on the alignment axis (`start`/`center`/`end`): `'flip'`: keep side, but swap `start` and `end` when the requested alignment overflows.`'shift'`: keep side and requested alignment, then nudge the popup along the alignment axis to fit.`'none'`: do not correct alignment-axis overflow. `fallbackAxisSide` controls fallback behavior on the perpendicular axis when the preferred axis cannot fit: `'start'`: allow perpendicular fallback and try the logical start side first (`top` before `bottom`, or `left` before `right` in LTR).`'end'`: allow perpendicular fallback and try the logical end side first (`bottom` before `top`, or `right` before `left` in LTR).`'none'`: do not fallback to the perpendicular axis. When `side` is `'shift'`, explicitly setting `align` only supports `'shift'` or `'none'`. If `align` is omitted, it defaults to `'flip'`.
props.name: collisionAvoidance

props.doc: An element or a rectangle that delimits the area that the popup is confined to.
props.name: collisionBoundary

props.doc: Additional space to maintain from the edge of the collision boundary.
props.name: collisionPadding

props.doc: Whether to maintain the popup in the viewport after the anchor element was scrolled out of view.
props.name: sticky

popover.Positioner.summary: Positions the popover against the trigger.

props.doc: Event handler called after any animations complete when the popover is opened or closed.

popover.Root.summary: Groups all parts of the popover.

props.doc: ID of the trigger. In addition to being forwarded to the rendered element, it is also used to specify the active trigger for the popover in controlled mode (with the Popover.Root `triggerId` prop).
props.name: id
